datasets.name: Landsat-8 (OLI) satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: The Landsat-(OLI) satellite imageries are downloaded from the earth explorer (https://earthexplorer.usgs.gov/) for the region of Row51 and path 145.

datasets.name: Landslide inventory dataset
datasets.source: Authors' own creation using MATLAB Image Labeler
datasets.verbatim: The labeled image for the inventory dataset is created using the image labeler app in MATLAB (https://in.mathworks.com/help/vision/ug/get-started-with-the-image-labe ler.html).

methods.name: Separable Factorized Convolution Network (SFCNet)
methods.summary: A lightweight deep learning model for pixel-based landslide detection that incorporates separable and factorized convolution to minimize the number of learnable parameters and computational complexity. It uses a parallel arrangement of multiscale factorized kernel sizes in the SFC module to extract local and global features.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is referenced and linked, and the Landsat-8 imagery is accessible via USGS Earth Explorer. However, the custom code for the SFCNet method is not available.
